title: Concept: Risky CI setting (writeall) — review required
description: For writeall, permissionss*:s*write-all widens what workflow code can do. CI executes untrusted contributions, so token and trigger scope are security boundaries. The remedy is per-job least privilege.
applicability: CI workflow files; single-line lexical scope.
risk: Secret theft or push-path abuse from untrusted code; MEDIUM severity, HIGH on public repos.
